skills.name: Sparrow Peck (雀啄)
skills.line: I will command my sparrows to hurt you.
skills.description: Nyuunai-suzume commands his sparrows to attack a single target dealing damage equal to 50% of his ATK. Also deals additional true damage equal to 50% of to his DEF and has a 40% to Assist.

skills.name: Possess (附身)
skills.description:
Exclusive effect. ;Upper Hand :Nyuunai-suzume automatically Possesses the ally with the highest attack at the start of battle. :When a Possessed ally receives lethal damage, the damage is negated and they cease to be Possessed. ;Upon Usage :Nyuunai-suzume Possesses another ally instead. ; : ;Decayed Blood (腐血) : :'''Buff, Mark''': HP cannot be restored or recovered. When receiving damage, Decayed Blood will be depleted first. Each point of Decayed Blood can absorb 3 points of damage. Allies with Decayed Blood have 10% decreased Crit and 25% increased damage dealt. ;Possess (附身/憑依) : :Unique to Nyuunai-suzume. Only a single ally can be Possessed at a time. Effect disappears when the ally ceases to be Possesed.
Possessed allies gain Nyuunai-suzume's initial DEF (cannot exceed 50% of his defense).
Nyuunai-suzume gains the initial ATK of the Possessed ally (cannot exceed 50% of their ATK).

upgrades.text: Possessed allies gain Nyuunai-suzume's initial DEF (cannot exceed 100% of his DEF).
Nyuunai-suzume gains the initial ATK of Possessed allies (cannot exceed 100% of their ATK).
When an ally ceases to be Possessed, Nyuunai-suzume's chance to Assist increases to 100%.
When an ally ceases to be Possessed, all controlling effects on them are removed and their move bar is increased by 100%.

skills.name: Decay (腐化)
skills.description:
Nyuunai-suzume deducts the max HP of an ally by 1000% of his initial DEF and grants them an equal amount of Decayed Blood (cannot exceed 50% of the target's max HP).
Cannot be used on allies with Decayed Blood. ;Decayed Blood (腐血) : :'''Buff, Mark''': HP cannot be restored or recovered. When receiving damage, Decayed Blood will be depleted first. Each point of Decayed Blood can absorb 3 points of damage. Allies with Decayed Blood have 10% decreased Crit and 25% increased damage dealt.

upgrades.text: For each ally with Decayed Blood, increases Nyuunai-suzume's SPD by 10.
For each ally with Decayed Blood, increases Nyuunai-suzume's RES by 20%.
Increases the effect of Decayed Blood to 2000% initial DEF.
For each ally with Decayed Blood, increases Nyuunai-suzume's damage reduction by 10%.

bio.condition: Obtain 8 Nyuunai-suzume shards from Demon Parade.
Fight in Realm Raid with Nyuunai-suzume 30 times.
